Employer contribution will be paid to the Provident Fund as per PF Act.

Monday to Saturday

During the first week of the probationary period, a notice of 1 day in writing or 1 day's salary in lieu thereof is required to be given to the other party by a party for terminating the employment. After the first week of the probationary period and before the probation confirmation, a notice of 7 days in writing or the equivalent of 7 days' salary in lieu thereof is required to be given to the other party in the event of termination of employment.


After the probationary period, either party is required to terminate the contract of employment by giving one month's notice in writing to the other or one month's salary in lieu thereof. The decision of the Management shall be final and binding in each case.

Any dispute between yourself and the Company concerning or relating to or arising out of our contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of and be determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.

11.1 You are to devote your whole time, attention and ability to the interest of the Company.


11.2 You are to treat as strictly confidential the affairs of the Company and its customers of which you may be cognizant and particularly any and all knowledge, information, know- how, trade secrets and data, whether technical, non-technical or computer-generated (Including, but not limited to plans, documents, quotations, specifications, etc., and any information obtained from these). 11.3 You shall not be engaged in any form of trade, business or employment other than that with the Company whether inside or outside your normal hours of work, unless explicitly agreed by a Director of {{COMPANY_NAME}} PVT LTD, the parent Company.

11.5 Any breach of any of the terms of this Contract will render you liable to termination of your employment without notice or compensation.


11.6 All the rights, titles and interests including intellectual property rights in all inventions, source codes, discoveries, developments, and innovations made, created, developed, written, produced or conceived by you during your employment with the Company pursuant to this contract or with the aid, assistance or use of the Company's resources, equipment, supplies, facilities or confidential information shall be the exclusive property of the Company and shall vest and remain at all times in the Company. 


11.7 You undertake and agree, promptly upon request, to do all such acts and execute such documents and provide any assistance to the Company in securing any such rights and benefits. Any and all inventions, discoveries, developments and innovations conceived by you prior to the term of this contract which are utilized by you in rendering your duties to the Company are hereby licensed to the Company, free of charge or free of any license fees whatsoever, for use in its operations in any and media by any manner or means now known or invented in the future.


11.8 This offer and the contract arising from the acceptance thereof is governed by and shall be consulted in accordance with the laws of India.

In accordance with the standard practice of our company, we request you to treat the terms of your employment as confidential. You will keep  us informed of your local/contact address or your latest personal particular whenever there is any change. Please sign and return to us the  duplicate copy of this letter in token of your agreement of the above.
